oil_rag.name: Oil rag
oil_rag.desc: Wipes the dusty plaques on the plinths.

owls_lens.name: Owl's Lens
owls_lens.desc: Shows faded ink, such as hidden lines on the prophecy scroll.

moon_candle.name: Moon-silver candle
moon_candle.desc: Its silver light reveals the prophecy on the lectern.

sun_shard.name: Sun Shard
sun_shard.desc: Powers the glowing socket in the forge.

crank.name: Hand crank
crank.desc: Fits the mirror stands so they can turn.

tide_compass.name: Tide Compass
tide_compass.desc: Shows east, west and north on the cave floor.

lantern.name: Brass lantern
lantern.desc: Hang it on the iron hook to read the wall poem.

climbing_straps.name: Climbing straps
climbing_straps.desc: Strap in at the rock ledge to cross the wet stones.

pearl_calm_waters.name: Pearl of Calm Waters
pearl_calm_waters.desc: Stills the black river so the toll stones can be read.

purse.name: Leather coin purse
purse.desc: Holds the 20 obols for the ferryman.

ferry_bell.name: Brass ferry bell
ferry_bell.desc: Hang it on the ferry post and ring for Oruk.

ferrymans_token.name: Ferryman's Token
ferrymans_token.desc: Opens the gate of the archive.

cipher_wheel.name: Bronze cipher wheel
cipher_wheel.desc: Helps shift letters to decode the door message.

library_ladder.name: Library ladder
library_ladder.desc: Lets you climb to the owl frieze.

mission.heading: The Undercliff
paragraphs: Halcyon Point hides the children of the gods. Beneath its cliffs burns the Ember of Olympus, the flame that keeps the old gods alive.
Tonight the Ember is dying, and someone at the academy let it happen.
You are Kade, with Isla beside you. Pass seven trials, reach the Throne, and save the Ember before ten minutes run out.

tutorial.text: Drag to look around the room.
Tap glowing objects to inspect, pick up or use them.
The Casebook holds your items and clue sentences.
Every panel has an X to close and a Pause button.
Kleos is your score. You have 2 hints per room that cost 25 Kleos. Wrong answers cost 10 Kleos and a short lockout. The clock is 10:00 and runs while you play.

beats: Kade lifts the Ember. It splits into twelve small flames.
The flames drift to twelve empty thrones and each throne lights.
Ostrava kneels. Isla: "Your mother is remembered now. Not by taking the Ember, but by sharing it."
Brindle: "The academy is warm again. I can feel it in the stones."
Kade, quietly: "One of those thrones is still dark." A thirteenth throne at the edge of the ring is empty and cold.
Far over the sea a thirteenth flame glows and answers the Ember. Isla's owl pin flickers toward it. Kade: "Whoever lit that one is still out there."

lose.title: The Ember Fades
lose.text: The Throne stays dark. Try again.

open1.speaker: isla
open1.text: The Ember's light is almost gone. I can feel the cold in the stone.

open2.speaker: kade
open2.text: Then we move fast. The old stairs are right here.

open3.speaker: brindle
open3.text: Please be careful. The Warden said the Undercliff is sealed tonight.

open4.speaker: kade
open4.text: Sealed, huh? Not from us. Let's go.

idle.speaker: brindle
idle.text: Try turning around. Drag to look around.

r1_enter1.speaker: isla
r1_enter1.text: An armory under the academy. I never knew it was here.

r1_enter2.speaker: kade
r1_enter2.text: Everything is chained up. Let's see who guards the keys.

r1_ledger.speaker: isla
r1_ledger.text: The seal on this page is the Warden's. Why would she lock this tonight?

r1_findrag.speaker: kade
r1_findrag.text: An oil rag. This should clean the dusty plaques on the plinths.

r1_wrong1.speaker: brindle
r1_wrong1.text: That one does not feel right. Read the plaque again.

r1_wrong2.speaker: brindle
r1_wrong2.text: Check the chart. Match the domain to the god, then the god to the symbol.

r1_wrong3.speaker: brindle
r1_wrong3.text: The sea god carries three points, the dead king two, the sky ruler a bolt.

r1_right1.speaker: isla
r1_right1.text: Every weapon sits with its god. The whole hall is humming.

r1_right2.speaker: kade
r1_right2.text: Something is glowing in the rack. It looks like a lens.

r1_right3.speaker: isla
r1_right3.text: An owl's lens, Athena's gift. It shows what ink hides.

r2_enter1.speaker: kade
r2_enter1.text: Dusty, dark and a ceiling full of stars. Very oracle.

r2_enter2.speaker: isla
r2_enter2.text: There is a prophecy on that lectern. Let's light it.

r2_portrait.speaker: isla
r2_portrait.text: Seer Lysa. The note says she cannot write anymore.

r2_findkey.speaker: kade
r2_findkey.text: A key tucked in a cushion. Classic. I bet it opens that cabinet.

r2_wrong1.speaker: brindle
r2_wrong1.text: The box did not like that. It wants a word, not a guess.

r2_wrong2.speaker: brindle
r2_wrong2.text: Look at how each line of the prophecy begins.

r2_wrong3.speaker: brindle
r2_wrong3.text: Read only the first letter of each line, from top to bottom.

r2_right1.speaker: isla
r2_right1.text: SHARE. The prophecy hid its own word.

r2_right2.speaker: kade
r2_right2.text: And the scratched-out line says the Ember burns only while it is shared.

r2_right3.speaker: isla
r2_right3.text: Someone rewrote it in violet ink. Remember that. Here, a shard of sunlight.

r3_enter1.speaker: isla
r3_enter1.text: A forge older than the academy. And a guard that is not breathing.

r3_enter2.speaker: kade
r3_enter2.text: The shard is warm. I think it wants to go in that socket.

r3_plate.speaker: isla
r3_plate.text: The log says someone in a gray cloak ordered the Ember's feed cut.

r3_findcrank.speaker: kade
r3_findcrank.text: A crank. These stands must turn. I will fit it to them.

r3_stuck1.speaker: brindle
r3_stuck1.text: Follow the beam with your eyes. Where does it leave the grid?

r3_stuck2.speaker: brindle
r3_stuck2.text: The beam must end in the guard's eye. Fix the first turn first.

r3_stuck3.speaker: brindle
r3_stuck3.text: Beam east, turn north, turn east, then turn south into the eye.

r3_right1.speaker: isla
r3_right1.text: The eye is lit. The guard is waking.

r3_right2.speaker: kade
r3_right2.text: He is bigger than he looked. But he is smiling.

r3_right3.speaker: guard
r3_right3.text: The sea way is dark. Take the Compass. North is the way of the stone.

r4_enter1.speaker: isla
r4_enter1.text: The whole floor is water and stones. One wrong step and we swim.

r4_enter2.speaker: kade
r4_enter2.text: There is a poem on the wall. Let's read it by lantern light.

r4_pool.speaker: isla
r4_pool.text: A gray cloak scrap with a sea-glass clasp. Someone came this way.

r4_findstraps.speaker: kade
r4_findstraps.text: Good grip. Let's strap in at that rock ledge and cross.

r4_wrong1.speaker: brindle
r4_wrong1.text: The wave took that stone. Go back to the last safe one.

r4_wrong2.speaker: brindle
r4_wrong2.text: The Compass shows east and west. Read the poem line by line.

r4_wrong3.speaker: brindle
r4_wrong3.text: East once, then north twice, then west twice, then north once.

r4_right1.speaker: isla
r4_right1.text: The altar is under our hands. The water has gone still.

r4_right2.speaker: kade
r4_right2.text: There is a pearl hollow here. And the pearl is already glowing.

r4_right3.speaker: isla
r4_right3.text: Pearl of Calm Waters. It will quiet any river.

r5_enter1.speaker: kade
r5_enter1.text: A river under a mountain. Of course there is a ferry.

r5_enter2.speaker: isla
r5_enter2.text: Three bowls and three crossings. This is a price puzzle.

r5_tally.speaker: isla
r5_tally.text: The Warden went down once. She never came back up.

r5_findpurse.speaker: kade
r5_findpurse.text: Twenty obols exactly. No spare coins. This pays the ferryman.

r5_bell.speaker: oruk
r5_bell.text: Three crossings. Pay the exact toll or swim.

r5_wrong1.speaker: brindle
r5_wrong1.text: The total is right but the split is wrong. Reread the stones.

r5_wrong2.speaker: brindle
r5_wrong2.text: The second toll is the key. The other two are measured against it.

r5_wrong3.speaker: brindle
r5_wrong3.text: If the second is four, then the first is eight and the third is eight.

r5_right1.speaker: isla
r5_right1.text: Eight, four and eight. Exactly twenty.

r5_right2.speaker: kade
r5_right2.text: The ferryman is nodding. He is handing something over.

r5_right3.speaker: isla
r5_right3.text: A Ferryman's Token. It opens the gate of the archive.

r6_enter1.speaker: isla
r6_enter1.text: An archive of everything the gods ever wrote down. I could live here.

r6_enter2.speaker: kade
r6_enter2.text: You could. We cannot. The door is sealed with a code.

r6_ledger.speaker: isla
r6_ledger.text: Only the Warden may sign orders to feed or cut the Ember.

r6_findwheel.speaker: kade
r6_findwheel.text: A cipher wheel. Now we have a way to read the door message.

r6_wrong1.speaker: brindle
r6_wrong1.text: That is not a word. The letters need to be moved.

r6_wrong2.speaker: brindle
r6_wrong2.text: Read the inscription under the owl frieze. It says how far to shift.

r6_wrong3.speaker: brindle
r6_wrong3.text: Move each letter back three places. K becomes H.

r6_right1.speaker: isla
r6_right1.text: HEARTH. The goddess who kept the home fire.

r6_right2.speaker: kade
r6_right2.text: The door is glowing red. A key is forming in the ash.

r6_right3.speaker: isla
r6_right3.text: The Hearth Key. It will open the Throne.

r7_enter1.speaker: isla
r7_enter1.text: The Throne hall. And someone is already here.

r7_enter2.speaker: ostrava
r7_enter2.text: You came a long way, children. Give me the Ember and go home.

r7_enter3.speaker: kade
r7_enter3.text: You sealed the Undercliff. You are the one who let it die.

r7_s1wrong1.speaker: brindle
r7_s1wrong1.text: Think about who could sign, who could seal, who could write.

r7_s1wrong2.speaker: brindle
r7_s1wrong2.text: Open the Casebook. Each sentence points to one person.

r7_s1wrong3.speaker: brindle
r7_s1wrong3.text: Seal, ink, cloak, ledger, tally. Every clue is the same person.

r7_s2wrong.speaker: brindle
r7_s2wrong.text: Watch the Ember again. Copy it, beat for beat.

r7_s3wrong1.speaker: brindle
r7_s3wrong1.text: Read the prophecy again. The scratched line is the answer.

r7_s3wrong2.speaker: brindle
r7_s3wrong2.text: The old law said the Ember must be shared.

r7_s3wrong3.speaker: brindle
r7_s3wrong3.text: The Ember burns only while it is shared.

r7_after1.speaker: ostrava
r7_after1.text: Yes. It was me. My mother, Hestia, was forgotten. I wanted the gods to remember her.

r7_after2.speaker: isla
r7_after2.text: The Ember is catching. It is warm again.

r7_after3.speaker: kade
r7_after3.text: Shared. That was always the law.

r1_findkey.speaker: isla
r1_findkey.text: A bronze key. It looks made for the chained weapon rack.

r2_findcandle.speaker: isla
r2_findcandle.text: A moon-silver candle. Its light should show the prophecy on the lectern.

r3_findcloth.speaker: isla
r3_findcloth.text: A polishing cloth. The mirror stands are filthy. Let's clean them.

r4_findlantern.speaker: isla
r4_findlantern.text: A brass lantern. Hung on the iron hook, it should light the poem on the wall.

r5_findbell.speaker: isla
r5_findbell.text: A ferry bell. Hang it on the ferry post and ring for the ferryman.

r6_findladder.speaker: isla
r6_findladder.text: A library ladder. I can use it to climb to the owl frieze.

clues.C1: The Armory was sealed with the Warden's master seal.
clues.C2: The altered prophecy was written in violet ink, the Warden's own ink.
clues.C3: The bronze guard was ordered to cut the Ember's feed by someone in a gray cloak with a sea-glass clasp.
clues.C4: A gray cloak scrap with a sea-glass clasp hangs on the Tide Cave rocks.
clues.C5: The ferryman's tally shows the Warden crossed down once and never came back up.
clues.C6: Only the Warden may sign orders that feed or cut the Ember.

rooms.name: Armory of Arms
rooms.objective: Wake the plinths and free the weapons.

lines: Look at the desk on the right. A rag and a key are lying there.
The rag hangs off the desk edge. The key rests beside the small bowl on top.
The plinths have dusty plaques. Use the rag on one of them.
Tap the glowing diamond on the middle plinth and choose the oil rag.
The weapon rack on the left is chained shut. Use the key on it.
Tap the glowing diamond on the rack and choose the bronze key.
Inspect the freed weapons and read the wall chart on the right.
Each weapon has a symbol engraved on its side. The chart links each god to a symbol.
Tap the glowing marker on the floor and match each weapon to its plinth.
The sea god carries three points, the dead king two, the sky ruler a bolt.

hotspots.name: Dusty plaques
hotspots.card: You wipe the plaques clean. Each one now names a domain.

notes.title: Plinth domains
notes.text: Ruler of sky and storm. Lord of the deep waters. King of the dead. Keeper of wisdom. Master of the forge.

hotspots.name: Chained weapon rack
hotspots.card: The chains fall away. Five weapons can be inspected.

views.title: Spear I
views.text: A thunderbolt is engraved on its side.

views.title: Spear II
views.text: A trident is engraved on its side. It has three points.

views.title: Spear III
views.text: A bident is engraved on its side. It has two points.

views.title: Shield and hammer
views.text: The round shield carries an owl. The war hammer carries a hammer.

hotspots.name: Wall chart
hotspots.card:
Zeus: ruler of sky and storm, thunderbolt.
Poseidon: lord of the deep waters, trident.
Hades: king of the dead, bident.
Athena: keeper of wisdom, owl.
Hephaestus: master of the forge, hammer.

views.title: The ledger
views.text: A leather ledger with a stiff cover and a wax seal.

views.title: The seal
views.text: The Warden's master seal. Coach Tarn has been on the mainland since noon.
views.alibi: Coach Tarn on the mainland since noon.

r1_panel.title: The Plinth Ring
r1_panel.intro: Tap a weapon, then tap the plinth it belongs to. Each plinth names a domain. The wall chart says which symbol each god carries, and the weapons show their symbols.

rooms.name: Oracle's Attic
rooms.objective: Read the prophecy and open the lockbox.

lines: A candle stands on the little desk on the right, and a key is tucked in a cushion.
The candle is under the portrait. The cushion is by the round window.
Light the prophecy on the lectern with the candle.
Tap the glowing diamond on the lectern and choose the candle.
The wooden cabinet is locked. Use the tripod key on it.
Tap the glowing diamond on the tall cabinet and choose the key.
Two lines of the prophecy are too faded to read. Use the Owl's Lens on the scroll.
Tap the diamond on the lectern again and choose the Owl's Lens.
Read the whole prophecy. It is saved in your Casebook.
Tap the glowing page on the unrolled scroll.
Open the lockbox in the cabinet. Its word is hidden in the prophecy.
Read only the first letter of each line, from top to bottom.

hotspots.name: Lectern
hotspots.card: In the silver light the scroll shows five lines. Two of them are too faded to read.

hotspots.name: Wooden cabinet
hotspots.card: Inside the cabinet sits a lockbox with five letter dials.

hotspots.name: Prophecy scroll
hotspots.card: Through the Owl's Lens the two faded lines appear.

hotspots.name: The prophecy
hotspots.card:
Seven doors guard the sea-bound flame,
Hold each gift the gods have given,
All who climb must lend a hand,
Run not alone, for the fire runs low,
Even a god is warmed by those who give.

views.title: The margin
views.text: A line has been scratched out here.

views.title: Violet ink
views.text: Under the Lens you read it: the Ember burns only while it is shared. Someone rewrote the prophecy in violet ink.
views.alibi: The scratched line: the Ember burns only while it is shared.

views.title: Seer Lysa
views.text: A blind seer in a gilded frame.

views.title: The note
views.text: A card under the frame: Lysa cannot write since her eyes failed.
views.alibi: Seer Lysa cannot write since her eyes failed.

r2_panel.title: The Lockbox
r2_panel.intro: Five dials, five letters. A word is hidden in the prophecy. Read the scroll again in the Casebook: look at how each line begins.

rooms.name: Forge of Bronze
rooms.objective: Wake the guard with a beam of light.

lines: Search the workbench on the left for a cloth and a crank.
Both lie on the bench, left of the sleeping guard.
Polish the mirror stands with the cloth, and fit the crank to a stand.
Tap the glowing diamonds on the left and right mirror stands and choose the item.
Put the Sun Shard into the glowing socket on the far left wall.
Tap the diamond on the furnace socket and choose the Sun Shard.
Tap the glowing marker on the floor and guide the beam into the guard's eye.
The beam enters on row 4. Set the first two mirrors to slash and the third to backslash.

hotspots.name: Left mirror stand
hotspots.card: You polish the mirrors. Each one now shows its shape.

notes.title: Mirror shapes
notes.text: A slash (/) turns a beam travelling east toward the north (up). A backslash (\) turns a beam travelling east toward the south (down). A beam going north that meets a slash turns east.

hotspots.name: Right mirror stand
hotspots.card: The crank fits. Each stand now turns between slash and backslash.

notes.title: The stands
notes.text: Each mirror stand turns between slash and backslash. Turning costs nothing. Three stands stand in the beam's way: one on row 4 and two on row 2.

views.title: The plate
views.text: A bronze plate on the sleeping guard, scratched with a work log.

views.title: The order
views.text: Someone in a gray cloak with a sea-glass clasp ordered the Ember's feed cut.

hotspots.name: Glowing wall socket
hotspots.card: The Sun Shard fits. A beam of light shoots east along row 4.

notes.title: The light beam
notes.text: The beam shoots east along row 4. A slash mirror turns east to north. A backslash turns east to south. The target is the guard's eye on the bottom row, column 4.

r3_panel.title: The Mirror Floor
r3_panel.intro: Guide the beam into the guard's eye on the bottom row. Tap a mirror to turn it. The Casebook has the rules of the beam.

rooms.name: Tide Cave
rooms.objective: Read the poem and cross the stones.

lines: A lantern hangs on the right wall and straps lie on the rocks beside it.
Both are on the right side of the cave.
Hang the lantern on the iron hook on the wall.
Tap the diamond just left of the painted lantern and choose the lantern.
Now read the poem carved into the wall.
Tap the glowing page near the hook.
Strap yourself in at the rock ledge on the left.
Tap the diamond on the left rocks and choose the straps.
Use the Tide Compass on the water.
Tap the diamond on the water below the stones and choose the compass.
Cross the stones by following the poem, one line at a time.
Start on the second stone of the first row. East once, north twice, west twice, north once.

hotspots.name: Iron hook
hotspots.card: Lantern light fills the wall. The carved poem can be read.

hotspots.name: Rock ledge
hotspots.card: Kade straps in at the ledge. Standing firm, he can see the stones as a grid.

notes.title: The stone field
notes.text: The stones form a grid of four rows and four columns. Rows count from the cave mouth (row 1) down to the altar (row 4). Columns count from the west (column 1) to the east (column 4).

views.title: The pool
views.text: Anemones and clear water between the rocks.

views.title: The scrap
views.text: A gray cloak scrap with a sea-glass clasp hangs on the rocks.

hotspots.name: Wall poem
hotspots.card:
Begin where the gull's shadow sleeps, on the second stone of the first row.
Step once toward the sunrise.
Climb two toward the altar's light.
Turn to the sunset, two stones, before the tide turns.
One more climb, and the altar is yours.

hotspots.name: Tide-water floor
hotspots.card: A compass rose shines on the floor. Sunrise is east, sunset is west, the altar is north.

notes.title: The compass
notes.text: Sunrise is east (right). Sunset is west (left). The altar is north (down).

r4_panel.title: The Stone Path
r4_panel.intro: Follow the poem from the cave mouth to the altar, one stone at a time. A wrong stone is swept away.

rooms.name: River Crossing
rooms.objective: Pay the ferryman the exact toll.

lines: A purse lies on the table at the right, and a bell hangs on the tall post.
Both are on the right side of the dock.
Hang the bell on the ferry post at the dock and ring it.
Tap the diamond on the lantern post of the ferry.
Use the Pearl of Calm Waters on the black river.
Tap the diamond on the dark water at the left and choose the pearl.
Read the three toll stones on the left.
Tap the glowing page on the middle stone.
Set the three bowls on the ferry rail.
Call the second toll x. The first is two x, the third is x plus four, and all three make twenty.

notes.title: The purse
notes.text: The old purse holds exactly 20 obols. No spare coins.

hotspots.name: Ferry post
hotspots.card: You hang the bell on the ferry post and ring it. A dry voice answers from the mist.

notes.title: Oruk
notes.text: Three crossings. Pay the exact toll or swim.

hotspots.name: Black river
hotspots.card: The river goes still. The carvings on the toll stones can be read.

hotspots.name: Toll stones
hotspots.card:
First stone: the first toll is twice the second.
Second stone: the third toll is four more than the second.
Third stone: all three tolls together cost twenty.

views.title: The board
views.text: Rows of scratches, one for every crossing.

views.title: The Warden
views.text: The Warden crossed down once and never came back up.
views.alibi: Oruk is chained to the ferry.

r5_panel.title: The Three Bowls
r5_panel.intro: Fill the three bowls. The toll stones say how the three tolls relate. Together they must come to exactly what the purse holds.

rooms.name: Archive of Wisdom
rooms.objective: Break the cipher on the sealed door.

lines: Use the Ferryman's Token on the archive gate on the right.
Tap the diamond on the gold gate and choose the token.
Find the cipher wheel in the desk drawer on the left, and the library ladder.
The drawer is in the front of the big desk. The ladder leans on the shelves.
Read the message above the door, then climb up and read the inscription under the owl frieze.
The frieze says how far to shift and which way. The message is saved in your Casebook.
Decode the message and enter it in the door slots.
Move every letter of KHDUWK back by three places.

hotspots.name: Archive gate
hotspots.card: The gate swings open. The whole archive can be explored.

views.title: The frieze
views.text: Owls are carved around the whole upper wall, watching the door.

views.title: The inscription
views.text: Carved beneath the owls: Three watchers keep the archive. Step back three, and the door will open.

views.title: The ledger
views.text: A thick ledger of signed orders.

views.title: The signature
views.text: Only the Warden may sign orders that feed or cut the Ember.

r6_panel.title: The Sealed Door
r6_panel.intro: Decode the carved message. The cipher wheel shifts every letter. The frieze inscription says by how much, and which way.

rooms.name: Throne of Olympus
rooms.objective: Name the culprit and rekindle the Ember.

lines: Tap the glowing marker on the central throne and name the culprit.
Open the Casebook. Every clue points to the same person.
Tap the brazier and copy the Ember's pattern.
Watch the order the sockets light up, then repeat it.
Tap the marker on the floor star and answer the Ember's law.
Remember Room 2's scratched line: the Ember burns only while it is shared.

r7_step1.title: The Accusation

questions.q: The Ember's feed was cut by ...

r7_step1.intro: Name who did each deed. Every clue is in the Casebook. Open it first if you are unsure.

r7_step2.title: The Rekindling
r7_step2.intro: The Ember will pulse over the six Boon sockets. Copy it beat for beat.

r7_step3.title: The Law of the Ember
options: The Ember burns brightest in one strong hand.
The Ember burns only while it is shared.
The Ember burns forever once it is locked away.
r7_step3.intro: The prophecy once named the Ember's law before the line was scratched out. Check the Casebook, then choose.

ui.timerPaused: The clock is stopped while paused.
ui.noItems: Nothing yet. Items you find are kept here.
ui.noNotes: No notes yet. Readings and clues are saved here.
ui.holdHelp: To use an item, tap a glowing diamond in the room and choose it. Or tap Hold here first.
ui.noItemsToUse: You have nothing to use here yet.
ui.noHints: No hints left in this room
ui.title: Legacy of Olympus
ui.wheel: Cipher wheel: shift each letter by
